memory_watchdog.scope: Whole owned experiment tree RSS sum; sampled response, not a kernel RSS quota. Includes retained descendants after reparenting and optional source-owned GPU provider samples.

profile_scope: Builtin100ms component profiler and default10ms structured trace thresholds; completed trace wall intervals are not sampledCPU. Missing timed-out profiles remain censored.
